name: bim_list_selection_sets
author: hprebar
title: List saved selection and search sets
description: Read-only inventory of the saved selection/search sets and folders: path, kind (search, explicit = static selection, folder), guid, prune-below-match and condition count; withConditions adds every search condition as text within a 40 000-character budget (sets past it are listed without conditions — ask for one folder). Use it as the record of what existed before bim_sync_search_sets applies anything (the full restore point is the NWD file) and to find old static sets or hand-made search sets. folder narrows to one folder path (e.g. HP BIMCoordinator/MEP); nothing is evaluated, so it is fast.

folder.description: Folder path to list, '/'-separated; empty = the whole Sets tree

withConditions.description: Include the search conditions as text (bounded)

notes: Calls HPNavis.BIMCoordinator.CoordinatorTools.ListSelectionSets (DocumentSelectionSets.RootItem walk, SearchCondition.ToString per condition when asked); at most 400 entries and 40 000 condition characters.
